title: A retrosynthetic disconnection
caption: Work backwards: disconnect the ester in ethyl ethanoate at the C–O bond to give two synthons, an acyl cation and an alkoxide. Their real equivalents are ethanoyl chloride and ethanol, which react directly.
alt: Ethyl ethanoate, a retrosynthetic arrow, the synthons CH₃CO⁺ and ⁻OC₂H₅, and the reagents ethanoyl chloride and ethanol.
description: Disconnect the C–O bond: synthons CH₃CO⁺ and C₂H₅O⁻.
